landing.heroSubtitle: Sessio automates group training management for sports coaches and schools. Confirmations, backfill, attendance — handled, so you can focus on coaching.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Everything you need to run group trainings — without the daily back-and-forth.
landing.feature1Desc: Participants are enrolled by default. Can't make it? One tap to cancel. No more chasing replies.
landing.feature2Desc: When someone cancels, waitlisted athletes get notified and can claim the spot right away.
landing.feature3Desc: Who's coming, who cancelled, how full each session is. Attendance, waitlist, groups — one dashboard.
landing.feature4Desc: Share a link — participants sign up in 30 seconds, straight from their phone.
landing.stepsSubtitle: Your participants can join right away.
landing.step1Desc: Set the sport, time, location, and group size.
landing.step2Desc: Share a link or join code. They sign up in seconds.
landing.step3Desc: Confirmations, reminders, backfill, and attendance — all automatic.
landing.ctaSubtitle: Free to start. No credit card needed.
